field.label: Enabled
field.comment: Enables semantic search for storefront catalog searches in this scope. When disabled, Magento uses its default catalog search.

field.label: Request Timeout (Seconds)
field.comment: Maximum time to wait for the AI server to embed a search query. A timeout fails the semantic request, and storefront searches fall back to Magento's default catalog search.

field.label: Use Previous Semantic Index During Rebuild
field.comment: Keeps the currently active semantic index available while a replacement index is being built. When disabled, storefront searches use Magento's default catalog search until the new semantic index becomes active.

field.label: Collapse Results by Product
field.comment: Returns at most one OpenSearch hit per product, preventing multiple chunks from the same product from consuming the result limit. When disabled, the result limit applies to chunk hits instead of distinct products.

field.label: Product Result Limit
field.comment: Maximum number of semantic candidates requested from OpenSearch before Magento applies catalog filters and pagination. Higher values can return more eligible products but increase search work and response size.

field.label: Minimum Score
field.comment: Excludes semantic matches with a lower similarity score. Higher values return fewer, more closely related results. The appropriate value depends on the embedding model and should be tuned with Test Semantic Search.

field.label: Embedder Query Template
field.comment: Formats the customer's search text before it is sent to the embedding model. The {text} placeholder is replaced with the query. Use the format recommended by the selected model.

field.label: Store Views for Indexing
field.comment:
Select the store views whose catalogs should be processed and added to the AI Search index. (This does not enable AI Search on the storefront.)
Changing this setting rebuilds the entire AI Search index.
field.tooltip: Changing this setting requires a full AI Search rebuild. The rebuild may send many requests to the configured AI server and take a significant amount of time.

field.label: Embedding API Protocol
field.comment:
Select the API protocol used by the AI server.
Changing this setting rebuilds the entire AI Search index.
field.tooltip: Changing this setting requires a full AI Search rebuild. The rebuild may send many requests to the configured AI server and take a significant amount of time.

field.label: Embedding Endpoint URL
field.comment: Enter the embedding endpoint URL of the local or remote AI server.

field.label: API Key
field.comment: Enter the API key used to authenticate with the AI server. Leave it empty for endpoints that do not require authentication.

field.label: Embedding Model
field.comment:
Enter the embedding model configured on the AI server.
Changing this setting rebuilds the entire AI Search index.
field.tooltip: Changing this setting requires a full AI Search rebuild. The rebuild may send many requests to the configured AI server and take a significant amount of time.

field.label: Vector Dimensions
field.comment:
Enter the number of vector dimensions defined by the embedding model specification.
Changing this setting rebuilds the entire AI Search index.
field.tooltip: Changing this setting requires a full AI Search rebuild. The rebuild may send many requests to the configured AI server and take a significant amount of time.

field.label: Request Timeout (Seconds)
field.comment: The number of seconds Magento waits for the AI server before an embedding request fails.

field.label: Embedder Document Template
field.comment:
Define the text sent to the embedding model for each document chunk. Use {title} for the document title and {text} for the chunk text. Follow the embedding model specification for the required format.
Changing this setting rebuilds the entire AI Search index.
field.tooltip: Changing this setting requires a full AI Search rebuild. The rebuild may send many requests to the configured AI server and take a significant amount of time.

field.label: Maximum Chunk Tokens
field.comment:
The estimated maximum number of tokens in each chunk. Smaller chunks create more vectors, while larger chunks create fewer vectors. This value must be lower than the maximum input token limit defined by the embedding model.
Changing this setting rebuilds the entire AI Search index.
field.tooltip: Changing this setting requires a full AI Search rebuild. The rebuild may send many requests to the configured AI server and take a significant amount of time.

field.label: Chunk Overlap Tokens
field.comment:
The estimated number of tokens repeated between neighboring chunks to preserve context.
Changing this setting rebuilds the entire AI Search index.
field.tooltip: Changing this setting requires a full AI Search rebuild. The rebuild may send many requests to the configured AI server and take a significant amount of time.

field.label: Estimated Characters per Token
field.comment:
The number of characters the module estimates as one token when splitting text into chunks.
Changing this setting rebuilds the entire AI Search index.
field.tooltip: Changing this setting requires a full AI Search rebuild. The rebuild may send many requests to the configured AI server and take a significant amount of time.

field.label: Vector Engine
field.comment:
Select the OpenSearch engine used for vector indexing and search.
Changing this setting rebuilds the entire AI Search index.
field.tooltip: Changing this setting requires a full AI Search rebuild. The rebuild may send many requests to the configured AI server and take a significant amount of time.

field.label: Vector Space
field.comment:
Select how OpenSearch compares search query vectors with catalog vectors. This setting affects the relevance scores.
Changing this setting rebuilds the entire AI Search index.
field.tooltip: Changing this setting requires a full AI Search rebuild. The rebuild may send many requests to the configured AI server and take a significant amount of time.

field.label: Enable Document Title
field.comment:
Choose whether to add a product attribute as the title of each document.
Changing this setting rebuilds the entire AI Search index.
field.tooltip: Changing this setting requires a full AI Search rebuild. The rebuild may send many requests to the configured AI server and take a significant amount of time.

field.label: Document Title
field.comment:
Select the product attribute used as the document title. Product Name is recommended for most catalogs.
Changing this setting rebuilds the entire AI Search index.
field.tooltip: Changing this setting requires a full AI Search rebuild. The rebuild may send many requests to the configured AI server and take a significant amount of time.

field.label: Documents
field.comment:
Select the product attributes used to create searchable documents. Each row also controls child product content and text parsing. The more descriptive the attribute content is, the better the search results can be. Prefer meaningful text rather than short option values.
Changing this setting rebuilds the entire AI Search index.
field.tooltip: Changing this setting requires a full AI Search rebuild. The rebuild may send many requests to the configured AI server and take a significant amount of time.

field.label: Enable Dynamic Document
field.comment:
Choose whether to create an additional document from product attributes and text templates for this store view.
Changing this setting rebuilds the entire AI Search index.
field.tooltip: Changing this setting requires a full AI Search rebuild. The rebuild may send many requests to the configured AI server and take a significant amount of time.

field.label: Dynamic Document
field.comment:
Create a deterministic product description from existing product attributes and text templates. All rows are combined into one searchable document. This is useful for catalogs without product descriptions.
Changing this setting rebuilds the entire AI Search index.
field.tooltip: Changing this setting requires a full AI Search rebuild. The rebuild may send many requests to the configured AI server and take a significant amount of time.

field.label: Batch Size
field.comment: The maximum number of products loaded, parsed, and split into chunks in one indexing batch.

field.label: Batch Size
field.comment: The maximum number of pending backlog items sent to the AI server in one embedding request during ingestion cron processing.

field.label: Concurrent Requests
field.comment: The maximum number of simultaneous embedding requests sent to the AI server during ingestion cron processing.

field.label: Maximum Runtime (Seconds)
field.comment: The maximum time for selecting new embedding batches during one ingestion cron run. After this time, the worker stops selecting new batches and allows requests already in progress to finish.

field.label: Batch Size
field.comment: The maximum number of vectors deleted from OpenSearch in one vector deletion request.

field.label: Maximum Runtime (Seconds)
field.comment: The maximum time the vector deletion cron selects new batches during one run. After this time, the cron stops selecting new batches and allows any current OpenSearch request to finish.

field.label: Attempt Threshold
field.comment: The maximum number of failed processing attempts for upsert and delete backlog items.

field.label: Result Retention (Hours)
field.comment: Completed and outdated backlog items are deleted by the cleanup cron after this many hours.

field.label: Lock Timeout (Seconds)
field.comment: The maximum time a full reindex waits when another process is updating the index version state.

field.label: Minimum Successful Full Reindex (%)
field.comment: The minimum percentage of full reindex backlog items that must be indexed successfully in OpenSearch before the target index is activated.
